failure_modes_overlap.warning: these are overlapping failure modes, NOT disjoint sets; do not sum them

no_best_label: The two arms are statistically indistinguishable, so naming the higher one 'best measured' would be post-selection - the same error class the project retracted in L-098 (frozen_idfonly=65.67 was chosen by max() over test data). Both arms are named; the gap is a range.
wording_correction: Earlier draft said the metric 'breaks'. Too strong. FR@3 is not faulty; it has a natural ceiling for multi-evidence retrieval. Correct statement: FR@3 cannot reach 1.0 on queries with more than three golds.
